Name: Minecraft portal obelisk
Author: cpid
Description:
Obelisks can teleport players, and so do the nether portals in Minecraft. ;P Now you have a chance to teleport in Stardew Valley using nether portals!

This mod will replace the four obelisks in this game with Minecraft nether portals. Some plants and animals are added around the portal to make each portal unique and fit with the overall game style. Hope you like this idea.

SMAPI and content patcher are required.

Manifest.Name: Minecraft Portal
Manifest.Description: Replace obelisks with Minecraft nether portals
